storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for Udemy makes it easy to save Udemy course videos to your computer for offline study.

How it works: Log in to Udemy, navigate to any lecture in a course you're enrolled in, and click the download button on the player or the extension icon. The extension uses Udemy's own API to fetch the video in the best available quality and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS streaming, DASH manifests, and direct video URLs automatically. For DASH streams with separate audio and video, the extension uses ffmpeg.wasm to merge them seamlessly in your browser. No external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required.

Key features:
- Direct Udemy API integration for reliable, high-quality downloads
- Bulk download entire courses — select lectures with checkboxes and download all
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Automatic quality selection up to 4K (2160p, 1080p, 720p, 480p)
- HLS and DASH stream processing with ffmpeg.wasm audio/video merging
- Download progress tracking
- DRM detection with clear error messaging
- Download history with search, filter, and export
- Configurable settings (quality, naming format, download folder)
- Dark-themed UI with sky blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Log in to Udemy in your browser
3. Navigate to a course lecture
4. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
5. Select lectures and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Log in to Udemy, navigate to a lecture page in a course you're enrolled in, then click the download button on the player or the extension icon. The video will download as MP4.

faq.question: Can I download an entire course at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension lists all lectures in the course with checkboxes. Select the lectures you want and click "Download All" to queue them.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension automatically selects the best available quality from Udemy's servers — up to 4K (2160p). Available resolutions depend on what Udemy provides for each lecture.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. For DASH streams, audio and video are automatically merged using ffmpeg.wasm.

faq.question: Do I need to be enrolled in the course?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension uses your Udemy login session to access course videos. You must be enrolled (free or paid) in the course to download its lectures.

faq.question: Why does it say "DRM protected"?
faq.answer: Some Udemy courses use DRM (Digital Rights Management) to prevent downloads. These videos cannot be downloaded by any browser extension. The extension will notify you when this is the case.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos are saved via your browser's save-as dialog. You can configure a default download folder name in the extension settings.

faq.question: Is my Udemy account safe?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension reads your existing Udemy login cookies to authenticate API requests — it never stores or transmits your Udemy credentials. SERP activation uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
